title: OpenJDK pull request tied to reported Java RCE stirs disclosure debate
summary: A Hacker News discussion on 19 November 2026 examined OpenJDK pull request \#32781, which is tied to a reported Java remote-code-execution vulnerability that the submission calls java4shell and says was reported in September 2026. The available material did not include a CVE identifier, severity rating, or affected-version list, so the technical scope remains unconfirmed. Commenters pointed to an Adoptium support issue in which the pull request&\#x27;s author said on 1 October that Oracle had asked them not to proceed until approval, and on 28 October that Oracle had taken the work over. The thread also debated whether an LLM-assisted research effort independently discovered the flaw or had read earlier public reports about it.
